title: Redirecting standard output and error streams
description: Walk through saving command output to files with >, appending with >>, and separating error streams with 2>.

steps.description: `>` redirects standard output (`stdout`) from the screen into `results.txt`. It creates `results.txt` if missing and overwrites the entire file if it already exists.
`>>` appends standard output to the end of `results.txt` instead of overwriting it. Use `>>` when you want to accumulate output across multiple runs.
`>` sends normal output (stream 1) to `out.txt`, while `2>` redirects the error stream (file descriptor 2, `stderr`) to `err.txt` so warnings and tracebacks stay separate from your results.
